comment: Per-sport live boards. KBO publishes the Phase 2 candidate formulas in ml/params (the same fits shadow scores). WNBA and NFL stay on the previous formulas. "mode" is the fallback when a sport is not listed. Env CG_PROJECTION_FORMULA=current|tuned overrides every sport for one run. Shadow still scores both formulas for every sport. After changing a sport, rerun that sport's refresh listed in docs/live_formulas.md.
